sources.note: Paragon Denali product page. Describes SaaS cloud-native EHR on Azure, key value props (reduced downtime, lower TCO, independence), testimonials from Ridgecrest Regional Hospital and Holzer Health System.
Clinical solutions page. High-level description of unified clinical documentation, workflow streamlining, billing optimization. Light on specific module details.

Ancillary solutions page. Describes pharmacy management (allergy/drug interaction alerts), radiology management (procedure tracking, film tracking), and laboratory management (auto-verification, delta checking, QM tools).

Revenue cycle solutions page. Describes end-to-end revenue cycle: registration, billing, claims management with PreBill editing, automated collections work queues, downtime registration, customizable reports.

All solutions overview. Lists broader Altera portfolio: Paragon and Sunrise EHRs, Practice Financial Platform, RCM Services, Practice Analytics, ERP (fiscal management, supply chain, human capital management).
ONC regulatory compliance page. Rendered mostly as a contact form with minimal content — JS-heavy page that didn't yield useful text.

Mandatory disclosures for Providers Management Inc. Shows a separate certified product ('Integrated Providers Patient Portal' v3.18) that requires Altera TouchWorks EHR. Confirms PMI is a client/practice group, not the Paragon developer.
Feb 2025 press release. Four community hospitals (Columbus Community, Pipeline Health, Sioux Falls Specialty, West Calcasieu Cameron) adopting Paragon Denali. Gives hospital sizes and locations.
Announcement of Harris completing acquisition of Allscripts hospital business in May 2022. Covers the origin of Altera Digital Health.
Announces Nabla AI ambient listening integration with Paragon Denali for automated clinical note generation.
KLAS Research review page for Altera Paragon. Notes Paragon as practical right-sized fit for community hospitals, not top-ranked for large acute settings.
EHR market share data. Places Altera at approximately 3.7% of U.S. hospitals and 4.1% of hospital beds.
Blog post announcing Paragon Denali. Describes Denali as cloud-native SaaS evolution of Paragon EHR, contrasts with classic on-premises deployment (2-4 hours monthly downtime vs minutes).
CarePath patient portal product page. ONC-compliant portal for patient access to health information, lab results, clinical summaries.
Constellation Software press release on Harris acquiring Allscripts hospital business for up to $700M.
